verdict.rationale: Twenty ships an official, documented CLI: the GitHub README calls it "the Twenty CLI" and shows `npx create-twenty-app` and `npx twenty app:publish`, and a dedicated docs page lists commands such as `dev` for live-sync. Its documented scope is app scaffolding, development and publishing, defining objects, fields and views as code. missing for 10: evidence of CLI commands for querying or modifying CRM records, AI-agent-oriented CLI usage or a full command reference, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Scaffold a new app with the Twenty CLI: npx create-twenty-app my-app
`dev` | Watch source files and live-sync changes
Define objects, fields, and views as code
